name: zapier-error-email-to-triage

deploy.description: Zapier's Code Zap failure alert email ("had an error" / "couldn't run") -> confirm the workflow is in the work.flowers account (getWorkflow; Knoxx Zaps alert the same inbox) -> find the failed run in run history and its failing step (getDurableRun) -> upsert a ticket in the Zapier Error Triage Notion database with the same signature the notion-workers errorsDelta used, so pre-existing tickets keep counting. Repeats bump Occurrences and reopen a Resolved ticket. Replaces the worker's hourly errorsDelta walk.

params.query: from:notifications@mail.zapier.com subject:("had an error" OR "couldn't run")

trigger.authentication_note: Gmail dennis@work.flowers (the non-shared connection, same as gmail-attachments-to-drive-by-type). Zapier sends Code Zap failure alerts to the Zap owner, which is this inbox for every work.flowers durable.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling 'New Email Matching Search', one run per alert email. The query only narrows what Gmail polls; the authoritative checks (exact sender, exact subject shape) are in extractAlert() in workflow.ts. Polling triggers on durables never re-fire for an id they already delivered (W6ZE93-VMEWP), which is harmless here: every alert is a new message.

notion.note: All three were created by the notion-workers zapier-durables-docs worker. The triage DB was detached from the worker on 2026-10-03 and is now an ordinary data source; the Zaps and Runs DBs are still worker-managed (read-only here, used only to link tickets). All three must be shared with the Zapier Notion integration (share the parent page Next-Gen Zaps DB).

zapier_api_note: Run history (raw runs API) and getWorkflow/getDurableRun use the durable's ambient SDK credentials via @zapier/zapier-sdk/experimental -- no connection binding. Verified with run-durable 2026-10-03.
